general.title: Settings
general.description: Company data for documents and the rules your buildings run on. Each change takes effect from the time you choose and is kept with its reason.

readOnlyTitle: Read-only while the subscription is suspended
readOnlyBody: Settings can be changed again once the subscription is reinstated.

key.invoice_min_lead_days: Days between issue and due date
key.access_work_order_window_hours: Door code for a work order

property.title: Building settings
property.description: Billing cycle, cut-off and grace per property. A value set here overrides the tenant's for the buildings of this property.

editor.title: Change {name}
editor.tenantScope: For every building of the tenant, unless a property sets its own.
editor.propertyScope: For the buildings of this property only.
editor.afterHoursHint: Hours after the cycle is computed without anyone issuing it
editor.estimateAllow: Allow estimates when a reading is missing

history.title: Versions of {name}
history.description: The platform default, your company's and the building's versions, newest first — a change scheduled for later is marked.

company.title: Company data
company.description: Printed on invoices, receipts and tax invoices.
company.editHint: Changes apply to documents issued from now on.
company.legalNameHint: As on the company or personal registration
company.vatHint: Invoices then show VAT and the VAT working figures appear in reports
company.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG, up to 2 MB
company.logoTooLarge: The image is larger than 2 MB

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.description: The accounts residents pay into. Adding or changing one is confirmed with a one-time code sent to the owner's phone.
bank.addHint: Payments go to this account once the code sent to your phone confirms it.
bank.accountNameHint: Exactly as the bank has it
bank.providerHint: The bank or gateway that issues the QR codes and confirms payments
bank.merchantRefHint: From the provider's merchant contract, when there is one
bank.buildingsHint: Leave all unticked for every building
bank.otpBody: Enter the code sent by SMS to confirm {bank} {account}.
bank.otpNeedsResend: Send a new code to confirm this account.
bank.removeBody: Residents can no longer pay into this {bank} account. Payments already received stay.
bank.emptyHint: Add the account residents pay into to issue invoices with a Thai QR.

members.title: Members
members.description: The people who work for your tenant and what each may do. Staff can be limited to some buildings.
members.inviteHint: They join with the role you choose once they accept.
members.buildingsHint: Leave all unticked for every building
members.removeBody: They lose access to this tenant at once. What they did stays in the audit log.

notifications.title: Notifications to residents
notifications.description: Which channels each resident message goes out on. Urgent messages ignore quiet hours.
notifications.quietHoursHint: Quiet hours are set on the General page.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Your consents as an operator and the residents' data requests to your tenant (PDPA).
privacy.consentsHint: Purposes you accepted; optional ones can be withdrawn at any time.

dsr.title: Data subject requests
dsr.description: Residents' requests about their data. PDPA gives 30 days to answer; overdue requests are marked.
dsr.notesHint: Kept with the request; required to reject

verify.title: Verify the person's identity?
verify.body: Record that you checked who made this {kind} request.

start.title: Start working on it?
start.body: The {kind} request moves to in progress.

fulfil.title: Fulfil the request?
fulfil.body: For access or portability an export file is produced; for erasure the person's data is anonymised where no legal hold applies. ({kind})

reject.title: Reject the request?
reject.body: Explain why in the notes — the person is told. ({kind})

support.title: Support access
support.description: Requests from getproperty support to read your data for a ticket. Nothing is changed under a grant, and every read is in your audit log.
support.approveTitle: Allow getproperty support to read your data?
support.hoursHint: The platform caps the hours; access ends by itself
support.denyBody: Support will not get access for this ticket.
support.liveTitle: {count, plural, one {Support can read your data now} other {# support grants are live}}
support.liveBody: Every read under a grant is listed in the <audit>audit log</audit>.

via.platform_admin_incident: Approved by the platform for an incident

support.emptyHint: Requests appear here when support needs to look at your data.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what and when in your tenant, including reads by support under a grant.

grants.title: Access grants
grants.description: Buildings or units you opened to another getproperty customer (a management company, a contractor) or that were opened to you.
grants.createHint: They see the building (or unit) in their own console with the access you choose.
grants.granteeHint: Ask the other tenant for their id
grants.modulesHint: Comma separated, e.g. readings, invoices; empty for all
grants.validToHint: Leave empty for no end date
grants.revokeBody: The other tenant loses access at once.
grants.emptyHint: Grants appear here when you open a building to another tenant.

signIn.title: Ways to sign in
signIn.description: How you can open this console. They belong to your own account, not to the organisation.
signIn.kept: Carries your LINE notifications, so it stays
signIn.removeTitle: Remove {provider} from your ways to sign in?
signIn.removeBody: You will no longer sign in with {provider}; use one of the other ways. You can add it again any time.
signIn.linked: {provider} added — you can sign in with {provider} next time.
signIn.footnote: getproperty never merges accounts by e-mail; an account that already belongs to someone else is not moved.

lineOa.title: Your LINE OA
lineOa.description: Send bills, repair updates and announcements to residents from your own LINE Official Account instead of getproperty’s

how.title: How to connect
how.step1: In LINE Developers, create a Messaging API channel for your LINE Official Account
how.step2: Copy its Channel ID, Channel secret and long-lived Channel access token here
how.step3: Paste the Webhook URL you get into the channel and turn on “Use webhook”
how.step4: Residents who follow the OA get a link to confirm; once they do, messages come from your OA

lineOa.shared: Until a resident confirms, their messages keep coming through getproperty’s LINE, so no bill is missed
lineOa.emptyHint: All messages are sent from getproperty’s LINE for now
lineOa.connectHint: Everything is in LINE Developers on that OA’s channel. We store it encrypted and never show it again
lineOa.scopeHint: Pick one building if each building has its own OA; buildings without one use the OA set for all buildings
lineOa.replaceNote: An OA already connected for this scope is replaced
lineOa.failedConnect: Saved, but LINE does not accept it yet. Check the access token and run the check again
lineOa.webhookHint: Paste it in LINE Developers › Messaging API › Webhook URL and turn on “Use webhook”
lineOa.linked: {count, plural, one {# resident confirmed} other {# residents confirmed}}
lineOa.revokeBody: Messages go back to getproperty’s LINE at once. Residents who confirmed must confirm again if you reconnect
